name: Marro
desc: Marro is a Chrysid NPC who resides on the islands of [Songseeker Wilds](location:songseeker_wilds). He is found sitting near the mine entrance trying to find something for his village's Elder. When talking to him, he tells us a little about the culture of his people and especially about the Chrysid Elders and their characteristics.
additional_info: -   Marro's racial variant appears to be Seer.
